# BCV Today

> Official Banco Central de Venezuela exchange rates (USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolívar), published as a static website and a free, read-only JSON API. Unofficial project, not affiliated with the bank.

The data comes from the rates the bank publishes on business days. No authentication is required: every endpoint is a public static JSON file served from GitHub Pages, so do not attempt OAuth/OIDC discovery or token exchange.

## Pages as Markdown

Every page is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or append `index.md` to its URL.

- [Home (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/index.md): today's official rates and FAQ
- [BCV dollar (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/dolar-bcv/index.md): USD/VES rate, quick conversions and the last 7 days
- [History (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/history/index.md): how the daily history is built
- [API documentation (Markdown)](https://bcv.today/api/index.md): endpoints, schema and examples

## API

- [Latest rate](https://bcv.today/api/v1/rate.json): `GET /api/v1/rate.json`, the rate currently in effect
- [History index](https://bcv.today/api/v1/history.json): `GET /api/v1/history.json`, up to the latest 1830 daily entries
- [Rate for one day](https://bcv.today/api/v1/history/2026-01-02.json): `GET /api/v1/history/{YYYY-MM-DD}.json`, one calendar-day snapshot
- [API status](https://bcv.today/api/v1/status.json): `GET /api/v1/status.json`, freshness, effective date and supported currencies
- [API documentation](https://bcv.today/api/): endpoints, response schema and code examples
- [OpenAPI description](https://bcv.today/openapi.json): machine-readable description of the endpoints

## Data notes

- Dates are ISO 8601 strings.
- `effective_date` is the official BCV validity date ("fecha valor"); `updated_at` is the UTC capture timestamp.
- On weekends and holidays, `effective_date` may point to the previous business day whose rate remains in effect.
- Older historical entries may omit currencies that were unavailable in the source data; currency fields are numeric when present.

## Discovery

- [API catalog](https://bcv.today/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset with docs, status and OpenAPI
- [Agent card](https://bcv.today/.well-known/agent-card.json): data-access capabilities for agents
- [Agent Skills](https://bcv.today/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): skill index, including the `bcv-rates` skill
- [auth.md](https://bcv.today/auth.md): authentication notes for agents; no registration or credentials are needed
- [AI catalog](https://bcv.today/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD / ai-catalog manifest of the API, agent card, skills and docs
- [Personal Agent Protocol](https://bcv.today/.well-known/poppy.json): website-only Poppy discovery document, with no sign-in
- [Sitemap](https://bcv.today/sitemap.xml): every page of the site

## Optional

- [Full agent context](https://bcv.today/llms-full.txt): the complete documentation in one plain-text file
- [Source code](https://github.com/grupoclip/bcv-api): scraper, site and API on GitHub
